capabilities: Fetch papers from PubMed, Crossref, Europe PMC and allowlisted RSS feeds
Filter results by topics, journal sources and keyword rules
Translate selected titles and abstracts via Ollama or online services
Show read-only Zotero match status and local PDF detection per paper
Generate agent prompts and save reading tasks
disambiguation: Not a tool that scans your own notes; it discovers and filters published literature from online sources.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.7+), runtime verified on macOS only. Translation is disabled by default and online services need explicit consent. The plugin does not launch an agent, download PDFs or write to Zotero; detailed guides live in external docs.
problem: Keeping up with new papers across several publication sources and reading foreign-language abstracts means leaving Obsidian and checking each service by hand.

relations.evidence: Zotero uses a local read-only API and may inspect local attachment headers.
Select Ollama or an online service, save, check the connection

summary: Literature discovery workspace that pulls papers from PubMed, Crossref, Europe PMC and RSS, filters them by topic and keywords, and translates abstracts.
